p: sang Moses and the children of: Praising God for the overthrow of his enemies, and their deliverance.
prepare him an habitation: To worship him in it.
man of war: In battle he always overcomes.
name: Always constant in his promises.
thee: Those who are enemies to God's people are his enemies.
gods: The scripture often so calls the mighty men of the world.
fearful in praises: Who ought to be praised with all fear and reverence.
habitation: That is, into the land of Canaan, or into mount Zion.
inheritance: Which was mount Zion, where later the temple was built.
dances: Signifying their great joy: a custom the Jews observed in certain situations, Jud 11:34 but it should not be used as a means to justify our wanton dances.
answered them: By singing the same song of thanksgiving.
Shur: Which was called Etham, Nu 33:8.
he proved them: That is, God, or Moses in God's name.
right in his sight: Which is, to do only what God commanded.
